A bill for an act relating to capital investment; appropriating money for Phase 2 of water infrastructure improvements in the city of Kandiyohi; authorizing the sale and issuance of state bonds.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+KANDIYOHI; WATER INFRASTRUCTURE. +]

[+Subdivision 1.+]

[+Appropriation.+]

[+$7,092,000 is appropriated from the bond proceeds fund to the Public Facilities Authority for a grant to the city of Kandiyohi to predesign, design, engineer, construct, and equip Phase 2 of water infrastructure improvements in the city of Kandiyohi. This appropriation includes money for two new wells and a water treatment facility to comply with drinking water safety standards. +]

[+Subd. 2.+]

[+Bond sale.+]

[+To provide the money appropriated in this section from the bond proceeds fund, the commissioner of management and budget shall sell and issue bonds of the state in an amount up to $7,092,000 in the manner, upon the terms, and with the effect prescribed by Minnesota Statutes, sections 16A.631 to 16A.675, and by the Minnesota Constitution, article XI, sections 4 to 7. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; appropriating money for Phase 2 of water infrastructure improvements in the city of Kandiyohi; authorizing the sale and issuance of state bonds.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. KANDIYOHI; WATER INFRASTRUCTURE.

Subdivision 1.

Appropriation.

$7,092,000 is appropriated from the bond proceeds fund to the Public Facilities Authority for a grant to the city of Kandiyohi to predesign, design, engineer, construct, and equip Phase 2 of water infrastructure improvements in the city of Kandiyohi. This appropriation includes money for two new wells and a water treatment facility to comply with drinking water safety standards.

Subd. 2.

Bond sale.

To provide the money appropriated in this section from the bond proceeds fund, the commissioner of management and budget shall sell and issue bonds of the state in an amount up to $7,092,000 in the manner, upon the terms, and with the effect prescribed by Minnesota Statutes, sections 16A.631 to 16A.675, and by the Minnesota Constitution, article XI, sections 4 to 7.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
additions: $7,092,000 is appropriated from the bond proceeds fund to the Public Facilities Authority for a grant to the city of Kandiyohi to predesign, design, engineer, construct, and equip Phase 2 of water infrastructure improvements in the city of Kandiyohi. This appropriation includes money for two new wells and a water treatment facility to comply with drinking water safety standards.

To provide the money appropriated in this section from the bond proceeds fund, the commissioner of management and budget shall sell and issue bonds of the state in an amount up to $7,092,000 in the manner, upon the terms, and with the effect prescribed by Minnesota Statutes, sections 16A.631 to 16A.675, and by the Minnesota Constitution, article XI, sections 4 to 7.
This section is effective the day following final enactment.
